projection.acceptance: Apply the restoration acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. A readiness conclusion with an exact external blocker is an accepted investigation handoff; it does not close the conditional implementation.

non_claims: No VoiceFixer source, checkpoint, weights, runtime, config, or restored audio is present, downloaded, imported, linked, or executed.
No real corpus, rights-cleared degraded/clean cohort, listening, device timing, benchmark, or release result is produced or claimed.
No provider registration, descriptor, registry, default, public API/ABI, shared build, CI, board, handoff, ruleset, or main change is made.
No network access or download is attempted; absent artifacts are not fabricated, reconstructed, mirrored, or substituted.
No sibling restoration/enhancement evidence is inherited, pooled, or treated as this task's result.
Missing, invalid, nonfinite, or adverse cases do not qualify; this package is proposal-only blocker evidence.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide immutable VoiceFixer source revision, reviewed license text, and per-file digests for the exact canonical implementation.
release_gates.title: Exact source provenance

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide reproducible pinned runtime and exact task geometry: sample rate, channels, frame/hop/reset/drain or offline boundary, degradation scope, and adapter contract.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Define a versioned optional adapter boundary preserving installed v0 behavior; no default/API/ABI/shared build change without independent review.
release_gates.title: API/ABI and installed-v0 compatibility

release_gates.reopen_condition: Run deterministic fixture conformance with 3x cold-start byte-identical regen and strict rejection of missing/invalid/nonfinite/adverse cases.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide rights-cleared matched Restoration-profile evidence: frozen corruption/metadata/clean baseline, degradation/burst/bandwidth strata, concealment/validity, decoded intervals, task-specific quality, peak/timing bounds, and controls.
release_gates.title: Matched Restoration evidence

release_gates.reopen_condition: Measure paced target-device/runtime CPU, memory, deadline, availability, and failure behavior for the exact configuration.
release_gates.title: Target execution and availability

release_gates.reopen_condition: Obtain exact-head independent review, hosted CI, and explicit release approval; missing/adverse results remain non-qualifying.
release_gates.title: Independent review and release decision
